## 🧑‍🔬 By day

- 🧠 **AI Developer @ BLACKLAKE, Frankfurt**: co-leading the AI department, shipping RAG pipelines and agentic workflows so companies' documents finally talk back
- 🎓 **M.Sc. AI & Machine Learning @ TU Darmstadt**: professionally convincing matrices to have opinions
- 🦾 **TA @ PEARL Lab**: Franka Panda perception → planning → control assignments for 61 students and one very patient robot arm
- 📄 **Main author, ACRA 2024**: LiDAR odometry and loop closure in an Australian botanic garden (eucalyptus trees: surprisingly good landmarks)
- 🏆 2× DAAD RISE Worldwide Scholar · co-ran jacobsHack!22 · English, French, Arabic, German (C1), Python (native), C++ (it's complicated)
- 🧭 **Trajectory:** Bremen → DFKI → Porto → Sydney → Darmstadt → Frankfurt. Drift accumulating, loop closure pending.
